summary: This code is setting up a custom component library for MDX (a tool that lets you use React components in markdown files). It takes all the default markdown components, keeps those, and then adds a custom TLDR component to the collection so it can be used in markdown documents.

explanations.8: The three dots (...) mean 'spread' — it's copying all the properties from MDXComponents into this new object, so we keep all the default markdown behavior.
explanations.11: We're explicitly adding the TLDR component to our object so that when someone writes markdown, they can use <TLDR /> tags and it will render our custom React component.
